custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test on an earlier day, with 4 in its bin at a cost of $10.00, so the Inventory Value report saved a figure for it on that earlier date (date A).
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425657 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425657-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  2. When: Do the item above one day before you run the test, then run the test the next day, so the report has saved a figure for that earlier date.
